pages.text: In the computer area of ​​the library, late at night at 23:20, there is no one around.

Lin Du is debugging a large job of csc1002. In order to prevent the program from reporting errors, she wrote a lot of nested logic to handle extreme situations. Shen Qinghe passed by the printed materials and stopped behind her screen. This was his first time seeing a freshman who wrote 1002 without using AI.
"You write too many exceptions. You try to use the algorithm to appease every input that may go wrong, which makes your code very bloated."
"I just think the system should be more inclusive. In reality, there are always surprises."

"The code does not need warmth, it needs robustness. The result of your trying to please all abnormal data is to make the entire program completely ineffective in terms of operating efficiency. This is not writing a program, but writing a 'wish list'."
Lin Du did not raise his head to argue, but silently deleted those rows of redundant logic, introduced an extremely concise penalty function, and pressed the run button again.
Seeing the instantaneous increase in running speed on the screen, Shen Qinghe took a serious look at the freshman for the first time.
"Lin Du, your code is more mature than your problem."

In the corner of the school cafe, Zhou Yan is in the first cold winter of her start-up company. One employer had an arrogant attitude and tried to use loopholes in the contract to lower their valuation. Zhou Yan was wearing a neatly tailored suit. He had obviously just had a meeting and was calmly quarreling with the other party on the phone.
Lin Du was sitting next to me and heard a few key words. She quickly searched and organized on her tablet and pushed a briefing on the employer's historical breach of contract in front of Zhou Yan.
"Freshmen now don't go to social gatherings, and they switch to business background?"
"Friendship is too inefficient. Sister Zhou, this list can help you take back the initiative in this negotiation."
"What do you want in return? Internship certificate, or extra points on the comprehensive test?"
"I need to enter your company's desensitized underlying database, and I want real audit samples. I provide the ammunition, and you are responsible for winning. Everyone gets what they need."
Zhou Yan showed a smile full of fighting spirit.
"Direct enough. In this school, most freshmen just want to be taken care of by me, and you want to sit on the same card table with me."

At the recruitment booth next to the playground, Gu Cheng stood in front of the "Yuanshan Support Mission" booth, sorting out a thick stack of letters from children. Due to the lack of "quantifiable results", the society faces the dilemma of having its funding cut. His expression was gentle but with a hint of unnoticeable loneliness.

Lin Du stood in front of the booth and looked at it for a long time. Instead of taking the flyer, she turned on the computer directly and showed a "psychological growth heat map" that she generated based on the high-frequency words in the letter.
"Senior Gu, feelings are the easiest thing to dissolve because they cannot be verified. But I made your 'ideal' into a chart."
"...I always thought that the feelings in these words could not be calculated."
"The calculation is to protect them. Ideals without skeletons will be shattered in the face of realistic assessment."

It was raining heavily, and the air was filled with a damp earthy smell. Zhou Yangang experienced a business game, and although he won, he was still tired. She stood under the eaves, her dark gray suit making her tall and straight, but also revealing a hint of inappropriate loneliness.
Lin Du I didn’t expect to meet Zhou Yan in the science and technology park, even when it was raining so hard. He opened the long black umbrella and walked to Zhou Yan.
"Mr. Zhou, it will take at least half an hour to wait for the bus in this rain. If you don't mind, can we go back to school together?"
"Lin Du, it's very lucky that we can appear here at the same time. You have always been good at choosing opportunities. Then I'm not welcome."
She stepped under the umbrella, and the distance between the two instantly became closer. You can smell the faint scent of fir on her body, mixed with the coolness of the rain.
The sound of rain covered up the hustle and bustle of the outside world, and the umbrella became a temporary absolute realm. Zhou Yan looked forward and threw out her temptation in a calm tone.

"Just now, the management asked me to guarantee that the algorithm weights can be modified at any time for the sake of profit. Lin Du, if you were me, would you become 'mediocre' in order to survive?"
TA3F·Stairwell / 18:15 pm

A sudden local trip caused a complete power outage in the teaching building. Emergency lighting gave off a dim glow. Without the roar of the server fans, the entire building fell into an ear-splitting silence.

Lin Du I just finished writing a core module of aie1902. Before I saved it, the screen went black. She walked out of the computer room with a hint of helplessness, pushed open the fire door of the emergency stairwell, and prepared to go downstairs to see the situation.
Using the emergency lights, she saw a person sitting on the steps at the corner.

Shen Qinghe. He didn't complain like other people irritated by power outages, nor did he scroll through his phone. He just sat quietly on the steps, looking at the peeling white wall opposite, as if he was concentrating on something.
"I just think the system should be more inclusive. In reality, there are always surprises."

"The code does not need warmth, it needs robustness. The result of your trying to please all abnormal data is to make the entire program completely ineffective in terms of operating efficiency. This is not writing a program, but writing a 'wish list'."
Lin Du did not raise his head to argue, but silently deleted those rows of redundant logic, introduced an extremely concise penalty function, and pressed the run button again.
Seeing the instantaneous increase in running speed on the screen, Shen Qinghe took a serious look at the freshman for the first time.
"Senior Shen, if you are reviewing the code in your mind right now, will I interrupt your train of thought if I walk over?"
"No. The power outage just stuck in the progress of the project I've been working on for a week. I'm just taking advantage of this quiet moment to straighten out the logic that just collapsed."
"Looks like your self-repair ability is much faster than the school's backup power supply. Got it straightened out?"
There is no computer or Internet. In this claustrophobic stairwell, the two of them can only talk in the most primitive way.

That's almost it. In fact, I was thinking just now that this kind of unexpected situation is what I usually hate the most. I like to have a traceable life and stay in the laboratory because the environment there is controllable.
There are too many uncontrollable factors such as social interactions, accidents, and pleasantries from the outside world, which consume a lot of energy.
So you've streamlined your life to the extreme? In addition to the computer room, it is also the dormitory. Block out all the things that you think are ‘unproductive’?
"This is the most comfortable and least labor-intensive way for me. If accidents are eliminated, life can always remain stable."

"Senior Shen, stability is indeed good. But you should also know that if a person always stays in the circle where he feels most comfortable and controllable, and refuses any surprises and changes, then he will indeed not make mistakes - but he will always stay there and cannot find a better way."
Shen Qinghe's eyes moved slightly. He turned his head and looked at Lin Du seriously.
"In order to break the current bottleneck, sometimes the system needs to actively introduce a little 'chaos' and 'accidents'. Shen Qinghe, your life is too step-by-step, so stable... it's a pity."
Facing the "absolute rational defense line" constructed by Shen Qinghe, in what capacity do you intend to be the "accident" that breaks his stable state?
"Mediocrity is just a temporary pass. I will survive first, and then change the rules back to what I like when I have accumulated enough chips."
Zhou Yan showed an expression of "Sure enough," and felt that Lin Du was very sober, but also lacked a little surprise.

"I will not choose this path. I have seen too many people extinguished because of compromise. If I become mediocre, I think... the light in my eyes will probably never shine under your umbrella again."
Zhou Yan looked at Lin Du's face carefully and sighed: "What a luxury of perseverance... But this is indeed what attracts me most about you."

pages.text: "If you never dare to accept a little uncontrollable change, you will never know what is out there."
Lin Du leaned forward slightly and looked at him directly in this dim stairwell.
"Senior Shen, do you want to try and include me in your life?"

Shen Qinghe's breathing stopped extremely slightly at this moment. For the first time, his always tight defense line encountered such a straightforward knock on the door. He did not retreat, but stared at Lin Du with his deep eyes, as if he was reassessing the freshman in front of him.
His voice was slightly hoarse, but he still tried to maintain his usual calm tone: "Lin Du, accepting a brand new person into your life involves taking a lot of risks... Do you trust me so much?"
"Do you think that in this school, the 'rule-abiding high-scoring students' have a better future, or the 'unruly troublemakers' like us who have a better future?"
Just when the air between the two was stretched to an extremely tight critical point by these few words of dialogue——

"Buzz--" Along with a dull sound of electricity, the incandescent lamp in the corridor lit up instantly, and the dazzling light filled the entire stairwell. The silent server in the computer room roared again.
The rules and light of the real world have returned.

Shen Qinghe Squinted his eyes slightly to adjust to the light. He stood up, patted his trouser legs, and looked down at Lin Du who was still sitting on the steps. The sense of privacy in the darkness just now was dispelled by the light, but the way he looked at Lin Du was completely different from before the power outage.
"The call is coming. Your project was not saved. If you go back now, you should be able to save most of it from the automatic backup."
"Don't worry, I have a good habit of saving files anytime and anywhere."
"A good habit of rigor."
He pushed open the fire door of the stairwell and paused before walking out.
"Lin Du, regarding the 'destabilizing accident' you just mentioned... I will seriously consider it."
The door closed and the footsteps moved deeper into the corridor.
"Rules are fences for the weak. The strong will only use the rules and then tear them apart."

Zhou Yan's hand holding the umbrella paused slightly, and then he let out a chuckle. There was no usual social courtesy in that laughter, but a kind of appreciation for meeting an opponent. She turned her head sideways, and the dim light of the street lamp danced in her pupils, like a fire that was ready to try.
"Tear it apart...ah, how dare you say it, Lin Du."
"This school is full of people who want to raise the fence, and you're the first person to say to my face that you're going to take it down."
She lowered her voice and tilted her body slightly towards Lin Du. The space under the umbrella seemed even narrower and more depressing.

"Since you want to disrupt the situation, you have to climb higher than them. Remember, when you tear up the rules, remember to hold my hand tightly - at that height, if a person falls, he will be shattered to pieces."
"Only restless people can walk side by side on a rainy night. I don't like scripts that are too obedient."

Zhou Yan stopped. The rain was noisy, but under this black umbrella, the world was so quiet that even each other's breathing could be clearly heard. She didn't look at Lin Du, but stared at the string of raindrops falling from the tip of the umbrella. The sharpness in her eyes was completely removed for the first time in front of Lin Du, revealing a hint of exhaustion.
"Script...yeah, I've been playing the 'excellent template' for so long that I've almost forgotten what it's like to not speak according to the lines."
"Originally, I thought you were just a variable in my plan. But now it seems..."
She smiled self-deprecatingly and straightened her wind-blown temples for Lin Du
"Since you don't like that script, let's go slower tonight. Let those 'rule-abiding people' go on their way. The place we want to go is not on their map."
Halfway through the journey, Zhou Yan suddenly started talking about her family.

"My parents are the kind of people who calculate the return on investment in everything. Growing up in that environment, I will instinctively push away all uncertain variables. Lin Du, what about you? Are you a variable that I can calculate?"

Library 5th floor, seminar area / evening
        21:00
Shen Qinghe occupied the long table by the window, with several algorithm books and his notebook piled in front of him. Lin Du is sitting opposite him, drawing a data flow diagram on a scratch paper.

In order to prepare for the mathematical modeling competition half a month later, Shen Qinghe accepted the team formation of Lin Du. These two people, who value efficiency so much, are surprisingly in tune together.

"There are too many abnormal extreme values ​​in the original data provided by the official. If you use conventional algorithms to force smoothing, the characteristics of this set of data will be eaten away."

"Since outliers themselves also carry information, don't smooth them. Reduce the dimensionality of the data, project it into an orthogonal space, and directly isolate vectors with excessive offsets for backup comparison."
“Instead of using deep learning to calculate weights, just use basic geometric dimensionality reduction to avoid computing power bottlenecks?”
“The simplest are often the most robust.”
"Try as you say."
"Lin Du, regarding the 'destabilizing accident' you just mentioned... I will seriously consider it."
The door closed and the footsteps moved deeper into the corridor.

Just when the two of them were progressing very quickly, a boy carrying a backpack (the second senior fellow of the Shen Qinghe research group) came over, pulled out a chair and sat next to Shen Qinghe.

"Qinghe, I've found you. I have to submit a core paper tomorrow, and there is a set of experimental data that can't produce the results I want. You can write code quickly, help me write a script to filter it, and help me get the picture out by the way. I need it tonight."
This kind of request is not uncommon in the laboratory - under the banner of "mutual assistance", it is natural to take up other people's time and labor results.
"I'm working on a modeling competition, and my schedule is full. And I don't understand the underlying logic of your biochemical experiment, so I can't write it randomly."

"When will the competition fail? My paper is the key assessment indicator that the tutor is keeping an eye on. You can make a ready-made template and run it for me. It won't take you half an hour. If you don't help me at all, if the tutor knows that you lack a 'team perspective', how will he guide you in the future?"

Shen Qinghe The hand holding the mouse tightened. He hates this kind of behavior that uses "interpersonal relationships" to disrupt his workflow. This kind of illogical moral kidnapping makes him feel physiologically irritated, but he doesn't bother to waste time arguing on this kind of thing.
Faced with this "moral pressure", how does Lin Du decide to help Shen Qinghe cut off this noise in its own way?
I come from an ordinary family, I don’t have an earth-shattering background, and I don’t have any trump cards worth using precise models to calculate.
Lin Du did not avoid Zhou Yan's gaze, and her tone was as frank as a showdown in the sun.

The reason why I can walk side by side with you under this umbrella is because of my own ability, every line of code I have written in the middle of the night, and every major project I have survived. Zhou Yan, what I want to talk to you about is the future, not the past that has been written to death.

Zhou Yan was stunned. In her eyes, which were accustomed to examining the other party's assets and background, the sense of defensiveness seemed to have been washed away by the heavy rain. She looked at Lin Du as if she were looking at a stranger who broke out from the primitive wilderness with bare hands.
...an ordinary family? Oh.

Zhou Yan let out a short laugh. She suddenly stretched out her left hand and patted Lin Du heavily on the shoulder. The force was very heavy, with a kind of recognition that she had never felt before.

I have seen too many puppets who wear designer suits but are full of scheming. You are the first person who dares to say the word "ordinary" in front of me with such confidence. Lin Du, if we don’t count the background, then we only count the future.
Since you are the same kind who started from scratch, hold your umbrella more firmly. What we want to win next is not just a school-level project.
I don’t want “family” to be a parameter you use to calculate me, and I don’t want it to be a label you put on me.

Lin Du stopped, turned around suddenly under the narrow umbrella, and looked directly into Zhou Yan's eyes. The sound of rain seemed to be isolated from some absolute realm at this moment, and Lin Du could feel the slightly chaotic heat coming from Zhou Yan's body.
If you really want to know me, you shouldn't go through my files or look for answers in that pile of cold data. You should be here -

Lin Du took half a step forward, the distance was so close that their clothes were almost touching. She stretched out her fingertips and pointed weakly at Zhou Yan's heart, her voice low and aggressive.
——Come and confirm for yourself what kind of variable I am. Do you dare, Senior Sister Zhou?

Zhou Yan was completely stunned. The social genius who had always been able to handle everything with ease, at this moment, his pupils contracted violently. She felt an unprecedented sense of control spreading from her fingertips.
...Are you crazy?

Zhou Yan let out a low laugh, which contained a bit of danger. She didn't flinch, but took half a step forward, with the tip of her nose almost touching Lin Du's forehead. The space under the umbrella seemed almost suffocating due to her approach.
No one dares to take the lead in my gaming field. Lin Du, you are the first. Since you want me to confirm it myself, you have to be prepared.
If it turns out that you are a variable that cannot be digested, I will... dismantle you to nothing.
Lin Du Closed the draft book, turned his head, and looked at the senior brother calmly. Her tone was not sharp, but it carried a sense of professionalism that could not be refuted.

"Brother, in order to introduce randomness, our competition model adds non-deterministic random seeds at the bottom. If we use our current environment to set your biochemical data, the results will be irreversible.

Once the blind review of core journals requires you to provide replication codes, your data will become an orphan. In order to save half an hour and take the academic risk that the data cannot be reproduced, this account does not make logical sense, right? "

The senior brother was stunned. He obviously did not dare to take the risk of "academic fraud" just to rush for time. His expression changed, and he found an excuse to pack up and leave. Shen Qinghe watched Lin Du use the most rigorous "reappearance of common sense" to force the opponent back without any blood, a faint smile appeared in his eyes.
Lin Du ignored the senior brother, but directly put on the headphones and inserted one into Shen Qinghe’s ear

The melodious white noise instantly blocked out the outside world. Lin Du made a "continue" gesture to Shen Qinghe, then turned to his senior brother and made a silent mouth gesture, with rejection written in his eyes.
After the senior brother left awkwardly, Shen Qinghe took off his headphones.
"I can't stand him squeezing you like this. Shen Qinghe, just keep your purity. I can help you filter out the noise."
Shen Qinghe realized for the first time that after this "variable" entered his life, it did not bring the chaos he was worried about, but gave him unprecedented peace.

After the senior brother left, the library returned to peace. Shen Qinghe did not start working immediately. He looked at Lin Du opposite who lowered his head to draw the matrix again, and suddenly said:
"Lin Du. In this school, everyone wants to take advantage of me; if I refuse, they will think that I am unreasonable."
He paused for a moment, and there was a real warmth in his cold eyes:
"You are the first one who is willing to sit across from me and help me block these meaningless consumption of people."

"Because you are more suitable for pure logic and algorithms. It would be a pity if even your concentration is blunted by those bad rules. I don't want my friend to be a good old guy who always compromises."
"Then you might be at a bit of a disadvantage. Because although I don't owe them any favors, I never like to owe my teammates."
He smoothly pushed a box of mints next to him to Lin Du's hand. The movement is very light.
"Go on. Try to build a preliminary model of projective dimensionality reduction tonight. If any derivation is stuck... you can interrupt my process at any time."
"Don't worry, I rarely get stuck."

Zhou Yan walked out from under the umbrella, and the rain left a few dark marks on the cuffs of her suit. She turned around, and the light from the sensor light hit the side of her face, making her look heroic.
She paused, her tone no longer businesslike and calm.
"Also, Lin Du. You don't need to call me Mr. Zhou, and you don't need to call me senior. From now on, in private, call me Zhou Yan."
When I returned to the dormitory that night, the coolness from the umbrella handle still lingered on Lin Du's fingertips, but my heart felt hot repeatedly because of that name.

Turn on the computer, and an encrypted folder labeled "ZY-Private" pops up on the screen. That was Zhou Yan's core trump card, and it was also a heavy letter of nomination that she personally handed to Lin Du. Looking at the flashing cursor on the screen, Lin Du realized that the rain last night not only wet the corners of his clothes, but also completely shattered the original clear boundaries between them.
The next day, 19:45. The air after the rain was still thick, and the old library looked like a tomb of old books sleeping in the dusk.
Lin Du Pushed open the creaking wooden door of the seminar room on the third floor. The incandescent lamps emitted a subtle hum in the silence, giving the room a deserted tone.

Zhou Yan is already there. She took off her handsome suit jacket from last night and wore only a neatly tailored white shirt. The cuffs were rolled up high, revealing the silver watch on her wrist that reflected cold light.
I've pre-reviewed the data in the permissions, and it's more complicated than I thought... Zhou Yan.
For the first time, Lin Du felt a subtle sense of transgression that crossed the boundary.
Zhou Yan's fingers tapping the keyboard paused for a second. She raised her head, and her sharp eyes lost the temptation and softness last night, replaced by an almost cruel focus.
Now that you have seen the hole cards, it means that you can no longer play the table.
The audit presentation is tomorrow morning. If you're not ready to join me in carving a hole in the system, it's not too late to regret it.
Now that I'm here, I have no intention of going back empty-handed. Let's get started.
Zhou Yan didn't speak anymore, but turned the secondary screen in front of him to the direction of Lin Du.
As the two laptops beeped at high speed at the same time, the originally ambiguous encounter was instantly cut into a high-intensity silent collaboration by cold codes and tight audit deadlines.
There was no unnecessary flirting, both of them were quick with their hands. Lin Du is writing a script to capture case data, and Zhou Yan is quickly screening legal articles.
Lin Du, pull out the files on big data maturity in 2024 separately. I need to see how they define ‘algorithmic fairness’. "
"It has been synced to your shared document. By the way, I wrote an automatic association script to help you match those laws with our underlying architecture."
"Thanks. Working with you will save me a lot of energy."

Zhou Yan's cell phone vibrated dullly on the desktop. The caller ID is: Zhao Yu (member of the Standing Committee of the Student Congress). This person had been pestering Zhou Yan on the grounds of "helping the company apply for a venue".

"Zhou Yan, aren't you done yet? I heard that your audit demonstration tomorrow has not passed the internal audit. I happen to know the teacher in the school's admissions office. As long as you can help me increase the proportion of 'campus entrepreneurship models' in your report, I can help you with the venue."

Zhao Yu's voice sounded particularly harsh in the empty and dull seminar room, and his sticky sense of superiority seemed to have followed the radio signal to his desk. Zhou Yan's rhythm of tapping the keyboard did not change, but Lin Du noticed that her fingertips holding the mouse turned slightly white due to exertion.
Shenzhen Bay Park / Winter Vacation Evening 17:30

On the southern coast during the winter vacation, there is no biting cold in the air, only as refreshing as ice-cold sparkling water. The mangroves in the distance turn deep purple under the setting sun, and one or two flying fish that disturb the waves occasionally jump out of the sea.
Shen Qinghe Today he wore a very ordinary dark blue hoodie and carried a black backpack that he usually used to carry his computer.

"I checked the tide table. The low tide at this point is the best time to see black-faced spoonbills. However, compared to staring at those birds that may fly away at any time, I think blowing in the wind on the plank road is more in line with the definition of 'holiday'."
"Senior Shen, I thought you would use a latitude and longitude instrument to find the best viewing position."
"Since I'm going out with you, being 'casual' is probably the highest priority right now."
The two of them squeezed in front of a stall selling curry fish eggs. Lin Du skillfully bought two skewers and handed one to Shen Qinghe.

Shen QingheObviously, it is rare to eat this kind of food that requires holding bamboo sticks and rich sauce on the street. He acted extremely carefully, trying to bite the round fish egg in a very upright manner.
A strong crosswind suddenly blew on the sea.
"Be careful—"

He subconsciously turned sideways to help Lin Du block the strong sea breeze. Because the movement range was a bit large, the bamboo stick used to stick fish eggs in his hand accidentally scratched the hem of his waist, leaving a faint trace of curry sauce.
Shen Qinghe Somewhat embarrassedly, he took out a wet tissue from his pocket and wiped it repeatedly. In the end, the stain became even bigger. Lin Du It’s rare to see him as cramped as he is now.
"I...I rarely encounter this kind of situation. This dress may not be clean."
Lin Du smiled and held his wrist to stop him from ruining the clothes.
"Don't wipe it, Shen Qinghe. If you wipe it again, your clothes will be scratched. Since it's stained, just treat it as a souvenir of this trip. Come on, I'll take you to buy a new one."

Shen Qinghe was pulled by her wrist and walked forward, her eyes fell on Lin Du's fingertips holding him, and the tips of her ears quietly turned red. For the first time, he felt that it was not so difficult to accept that his plan was disrupted.

In a crowded shopping mall, you picked out a sweatshirt with a punk pattern on it for Shen Qinghe. Looking at him looking a little clumsy in front of the dressing mirror, pulling at the corners of his clothes all the time, what do you decide to do?

Lin Du Listening to the self-righteous chips on the other end of the phone, there was a physical discomfort in my chest. She did not try to seize the right to speak, but quickly typed a line of red words in the public comment column of the document and accurately pushed it to the center of Zhou Yan's home screen.

Zhou Yan's eyes stayed on that line of red letters for half a second, and the corners of his originally tight lips rose slightly in an almost imperceptible arc. She said coldly to the other end of the phone: "Standing Committee Member Zhao, the proportion of 'model' is calculated, not written. I think the venue matter should be handled publicly according to procedures."
After hanging up the phone neatly, the seminar room fell into a brief silence. Lin Du closed the computer and looked directly at Zhou Yan with clear eyes.
Zhou Yan, your plan has completed the closed loop and is logically self-consistent.
Accepting this kind of unequal benefit exchange for a temporary venue will not only burden you with an unfulfilled debt of gratitude, but will also destroy the purity of this algorithm.
You don’t need a savior, you just need to trust the data we have.

Zhou Yan looked at Lin Du with a look as if he was looking at his partner again for the first time. She did not refute this slightly presumptuous advice, but instead felt a long-lost sense of lightness without having to bear the pressure of decision-making alone.

Hearing Zhao Yu's almost charitable tone, Lin Du's fingers on the keyboard paused slightly. From the corner of her eye, she saw Zhou Yan's frown - what Zhou Yan hates most is having his weaknesses seen, and he doesn't need cheap sympathy.

Lin Du did not speak or show unnecessary emotions. She just stood up quietly, walked to the water dispenser, took a glass of warm water, and gently placed it next to Zhou Yan's hand. Then, she conveniently reduced the bouncing caller ID window on Zhou Yan's home screen to the corner and covered it with a running, complex chart with strict logic.

After hanging up the phone, the seminar room fell into a reassuring silence. Lin Du took off the earphones and did not ask about the content of the call. Instead, he handed over a pen and pointed at a data node on the screen.

Lin Du walked forward, stretched out his hand naturally, helped him straighten the drawstring of his new clothes, and smoothed his collar at the same time.
"This one suits you very well, Shen Qinghe. Don't always wear those gray and black ones. Sometimes you look... very energetic like this. Don't move, the collar is turned in."

Shen Qinghe He ​​held his breath and stood motionless, like a frozen stone statue. He could smell the faint scent of shampoo on Lin Du. He didn't dare to look at Lin Du at all. He just stared at his toes and whispered: "...you just think it looks good."
Shen Qinghe I silently recorded the feel of this dress in my mind. In his originally only world of black, white and gray, it was painted with a bright color for the first time.
Lin Du took two steps back, looked at him, whistled deliberately, and then patted him on the shoulder.

"You're so handsome, handsome guy Shen. When you walk out of this door, someone will probably ask you for your contact information. Then don't be like before, so embarrassed that you can't even walk."
Shen Qinghe scratched his hair in embarrassment and put the hood of his sweatshirt on his head, trying to cover his hot face.
"I...I won't give it to them. I'm not that...incapable of walking."
Shen Qinghe's tense body relaxed, and he realized that in front of Lin Du, he didn't have to be the "senior who made no mistakes".
"You are the first person in this school to sit across from me and talk to me about 'logical purity'."
"I just don't want to waste time on inefficient games. Zhou Yan, you don't actually need to put yourself in that impeccable shell, at least not in front of me."
"If you could find that logic flaw earlier next time, I might actually be able to stop pretending for a while."
She stood up and slid an unopened bottle of water that had been placed in the middle of the table in front of Lin Du.
"Go back to the dormitory, Lin Du. At the ten o'clock demonstration tomorrow morning, we will give those guys who only understand the exchange of interests a little shock of 'logical purity'."
"Then what? When the project is completed, how will Mr. Zhou plan to reward your chief partner?"
Zhou Yan looked out the window at the silent campus, with a rare and somewhat dangerous curve on his lips.
"By the time finals week is over, we need a...complete, incalculable yaw."
As the last audit report passed in the school hall, the smoke of finals week finally dissipated in the winter rain on the border between Shenzhen and Hong Kong.

That week, Lin Du and Zhou Yan had almost no private communication. They cooperated tacitly at the reporting site, like two machines that fit together perfectly, sweeping away all doubts. When Lin Du thought that their relationship would return to being a "partner" with the end of the project, she received a coordinate positioning message on New Year's Eve.
